checks.setup: Front oblique and side sheets inspected; complete body and apparatus visible.
checks.hands: Both closed hands remain fixed to the parallel bars.
checks.feet: Straight arms support the body while shoulder elevation and depression lower and raise the torso; feet remain clear of the floor.
checks.movement: Keep arms straight and hands fixed on parallel bars. Depress shoulder girdle to raise body, pause, then return slowly. Legs remain slightly forward without swinging.

limitations: Procedural demonstration; support samples are not full collision or biomechanical certification.
Timing is illustrative. Holds show the maintained position only; entry and exit are not animated.
